contradictionsResolved.topic: Is HeroAtmosphere wired? (adversarial F-1 says imported by nothing; motion M-01 observed it rendering under ?gl=force)
contradictionsResolved.why: Verified this session: `grep -rn 'HeroAtmosphere\|CareerStrata' app components -l` returns components/sections/Hero/Hero.tsx and components/sections/Experience/Experience.tsx as importers. components/gl/useGLCapability.ts:34-40 rejects swiftshader/llvmpipe renderers unless ?gl=force, so the adversarial zero-canvas census is the software-raster fallback path, not dead code. The adversarial observation (0 canvas on this host, and therefore for every no-GPU reader) stands; the 'imported by nothing' cause does not. F-1 is re-scoped to: (a) #listen has no visual in any path, (b) hero/experience fallback path is flat, (c) real-GPU behaviour is Assumed, not Verified.

contradictionsResolved.topic: Gold backgrounds in #skills: adversarial F-3 (14 gold backgroundColor = forbidden fill) vs motion M-07 (Bench gold is on production evidence, as designed)
contradictionsResolved.why: CLAUDE.md permits gold on the 'measured in production' mark; a 4px dot drawn via background-color is that mark, so the 14 #skills hits are contract-legitimate only if each dot sits on a production-sourced fact. Direction: keep the dots that do, re-express them so a literal `background: var(--gold)` audit gate can be enforced, demote any dot that does not. The single #listen gold background (F-3) is the same hairline composition C3 measured; both reviewers agree it marks no figure — remove.
